title: Per-dispatch structured result (runs/NNN/result.json)
description: Structured outcome + gate evidence keyed to the dispatch envelope (stage2-dispatcher-plan.md P0-6). A failed REQUIRED gate blocks acceptance; design/local/shared/live stages are distinct; a result is validated against the envelope (task_sha256, fence) before consumption.

task_sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of the task.md this result answers; must equal the envelope's

fence.description: The fence token under which the work ran

baseline_ref.description: Provenance id of the captured baseline (baseline.py manifest)

stage.description: What was actually exercised. A 'local'/dev result NEVER asserts 'live' delivery/acceptance.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence (command + result, file link). Required for pass/fail.

teaches.description: Learning handoff (P1-b). Recommended; never a gate on engineering acceptance.

deferred.description: One-line optional work postponed to the single hardening list; never an acceptance-path safety defect.

new_files.description: Every new path created for this task; coordinator checks each against required deliverables.
